g.community_id = e.community_id AND g.elder_id = e.id AND g.revoked = FALSE AND g.expires_at > #{now} AND g.binding_id = eb.id AND g.binding_version = eb.version AND g.granted_by = eb.account_id AND AND recipient.id = g.recipient_id AND recipient.community_id = e.community_id AND recipient.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((g.scope = 'FAMILY_READ' AND recipient.role = 'FAMILY') OR (g.scope = 'COMMUNITY_ASSIST' AND recipient.role = 'COMMUNITY_OPERATOR')) AND e.status = 'ACTIVE'

e.community_id = #{actor.communityId}

AND 1 = 0
